findings.claim: Tesseract (tel/tam/kan/mal+hin+eng open stack) on 400 L2 smoke pages: 31 empty, concentrated in Malayalam (ml_*); counts are non-empty-ness only, not accuracy
anuvaad_tesseract (anuvaad_tel/tam/kan/mal + hin + eng) is no better than stock Tesseract on emptiness: Malayalam still empty (ml_020, ml_035, ml_036)
tesseract_bilingual (eng+tel/tam/kan/mal+hin) gives identical counts and identical best/worst pages to tesseract_indic; stack order change is a no-op
openbharatocr is an ID-card library (Aadhaar/PAN/DL/passport/voter ID); on full pages it falls back to tesseract_indic, output is a twin (same counts and chars). Not an independent SOTA
RapidOCR has no Malayalam rec model: all 100 ml pages return honest-empty (no mojibake). 25% empty overall; lowest total chars of all engines
RapidOCR models: te/ta PP-OCRv5, kn LangRec.KA PP-OCRv4, ml none; Mobile rec/det, Det lang CH, Cls off
PaddleOCR: te/ta PP-OCRv5, kn->ka PP-OCRv3, ml unsupported -> falls back to English stack (wrong-script); ml_020/025/035 still empty. Only 7 empty (1.8%) overall
PaddleOCR two-stage graceful degradation: full pipeline (server det + lang rec, 300s) then light retry (mobile det, input capped 960, 900s); poisoned-mode set avoids re-entering timed-out instances

EasyOCR 1.7.2: Dravidian models pairwise-incompatible (te/ta/kn each only with en); Devanagari family hi+mr+ne+en works; strategy runs te+en, ta+en, kn+en, hi+mr+ne+en and keeps longest output; no Malayalam model; Tamil charset patched (143 classes vs 126 bundled)
'Keep longest output' selection in EasyOCR inflates char counts (ta_055 4466 chars, highest of all engines) - char count is not a quality metric
docTR 1.1.0 crnn_vgg16_bn pretrained (Latin-trained) emits text on Indic pages: 11 empty, ~1.1M chars - char counts are unverified garbage-risk, no script-correctness check

Surya 0.22.1 (surya-2, ~650M VLM): layout -> per-block recognition (full_page=False), text from block.html, fallback full_page=True if <5 chars; claims te/ta/kn/ml support; ml still empty on ml_020/025/035
Surya licence: code Apache-2.0; weights modified AI Pubs OpenRAIL-M, free for research/personal/startups under ~$5M funding/revenue; NOT free for large commercial or competing-with-Datalab-API use

IndicPhotoOCR (IIIT-H, PARSeq trust-patched) run on CPU, identifier_lang=auto, init once per process; this is a scene-text engine run on printed pages here; 10 empty (2.5%), ~1,050,000 chars; same ml_020/025/035 empty
Malayalam is the universal weak cell in this smoke: ml_020, ml_025, ml_035 empty across tesseract, doctr, easyocr, indicphotoocr, paddle, surya; only RapidOCR has all 100 ml empty by design
All engine docs only report emptiness counts and chars on 400 pages; no CER/WER or ground truth, so no engine ranking is derivable from these docs

Shared harness: 400 pages (te/ta/kn/ml prefixes, ~100 each: rapidocr 100 ml empty), PDF rendered to PNG at 200 DPI, 300s timeout, 1 retry with Otsu-binarized variant, no deskew (skew correction never implemented)
Operator directive 'OPEN POLICY': read any script on the page, no language restriction; stack all Indic models + eng for mixed books

Output is Level-1-style JSON: page_id, source, lang, script, modality, domain, quality_tier; missing [L2] if empty; unreadable_reason ocr_empty; engine_meta (dpi=200); single paragraph region with full-page bbox - no word/line boxes
Label inconsistency: page_ids with prefix ta_ (ta_055, ta_057, ta_068, ta_034) are annotated 'Telugu govt form' in notes; ta should be Tamil
RapidOCR version mismatch: PROMPT says RapidOCR 3.9.x with LangRec/OCRVersion enums, RUN says rapidocr-onnxruntime 1.4.4
Tesseract 5.5.2 is the version used across tesseract_indic, bilingual, anuvaad stacks

Anuvaad tessdata only covers te/ta/kn/ml (anuvaad_tel/tam/kan/mal); stack anuvaad_xxx+hin+eng, falls back to anuvaad_xxx alone if stack fails; tessdata at level2/research/smoke/anuvaad_tesseract/tessdata

plan_v4_gaps: Plan v4 Tesseract fallback: these docs show Tesseract (any stack) leaves 7.8% of te/ta/kn/ml pages empty, concentrated in ml; fallback must handle empties (tesseract_indic/RUN.md:4-7,20)
Tesseract open stack incl. hin+eng, anuvaad variants and bilingual ordering give identical counts - no gain from stack variants; skip them (tesseract_bilingual/RUN.md:4-7)

IndicPhotoOCR as used here is a line/word scene engine on full pages (10 empty); plan's Handwriting Expert reuses its PARSeq checkpoints but docs give no accuracy, only non-emptiness (indicphotoocr/RUN.md:4-7)
No Bengali anywhere in these engine docs: smoke covers only te/ta/kn/ml; Bengali engine behaviour is unmeasured here (tesseract_indic/PROMPT.md:4)
No CER/WER or GT in engine docs; any engine comparison must use a real gold set, not char counts (easyocr/RUN.md:12)
Surya weights licence limits (~$5M, no competing use) matter if product/jury use is commercial (surya/PROMPT.md:27-29)
Skew correction was never implemented in the harness; plan R4 OldScan restoration/deskew has no baseline (tesseract_indic/PROMPT.md:18)
contradictions: ta_ page ids labelled Telugu in notes (tesseract_indic/RUN.md:11)
PaddleOCR PROMPT says ml falls back to en yet ml pages empty; fallback produces nothing useful (paddleocr_indic/RUN.md:15-17)
